title: Case cache hit ratios
description: Per call site that allows a cache, the hit ratio and stale share of a TTL cache over the session model's key streams (MiSArch: models/domain-cache-hits.json, written by cases/misarch/generator/cache_hits.py). core/generator/derive.py class Structure reads the run `day/zipf` (the model's profile, Zipf popularity) and ttlSeconds. The site names are the generated model's call sites, so the file is regenerated after the model's call sites change (GEN_HITS_BOOTSTRAP=1 tolerates missing sites).

ttlSeconds.description: Cache TTL in seconds (derive Structure: source label).

zipfS.description: Zipf exponent of the product popularity (informative).

site.description: Cache statistics of one call site. Also carries (not read by the generator): hits, staleHits.

hitRatio.description: hits / lookups (derive: CallSite.hitRatio; joinCache hit branch).

staleShare.description: Share of the hits whose key was written after it was cached (derive: CallSite.staleShare).

lookups.description: Lookups; a site without any falls back to the base SEFF's site (derive generate call sites).

run.description: One key-popularity run of the model's profile. Also carries (not read by the generator): meta (sessions, requests, window, unknownClasses).
